result.title: Unveil the Mask: Jointly-Optimized Diffusion Masked Pretraining for Appearance-Agnostic Operator Verification
result.comment: Accepted at ACCV 2026 Workshop on Who Is Behind the Avatar? (WBA)
result.summary: Photorealistic avatar videos decouple the appearance of a rendered face from the person who operates it, which makes conventional face recognition unsuitable for identifying the operator. Verifying the operator therefore requires representations of how a face moves that are insensitive to what the avatar looks like. We propose a verification framework built without any external pretrained model. It uses two complementary modalities provided for each sample: facial landmark sequences and video frames. From the landmark modality, it learns motion representations by diffusion masked pretraining over grouped landmarks, guided by lightweight auxiliary tasks that predict behavioral cues such as motion intensity and eye openness, and turns them into operator embeddings with a contrastive linear probe. To generalize to unseen avatar generators, the pretraining input is randomly transformed to simulate how a generator may alter the operator's motion. From the video modality, it captures fine facial motion through differences between consecutive frames. The embeddings of the two modalities are combined into one. Our approach reaches an overall AUC of 0.769 on the WBA2026 benchmark. Linear probing shows that the video embedding retains little information about the avatar's identity, whereas the landmark embedding retains some, and fusing the two modalities improves verification in particular across speaking and listening modes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究虚拟形象视频中「操作者」的身份验证：不使用外部预训练模型，对每个样本的 landmark 序列做分组 masking 的 diffusion 预训练，辅以运动强度、睁眼程度等行为线索预测任务，并用对比线性探针得到操作者 embedding，再与相邻帧差分支的视频 embedding 融合，在 WBA2026 上取得 0.769 总体 AUC。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「diffusion 式掩码预训练 + 辅助线索监督 + 外观无关约束」的表示学习路线，可能为 LVR 中如何让 latent 保留运动与几何细节、抑制外观冗余信息坍缩提供可核查的方法线索，但本身不涉及多模态推理或推理期状态生成。
